name: Aspalathus linearis extract
description: Aspalathus linearis extract (CAS 776295-36-4 ), derived from the South African rooibos plant, is sourced for its concentrated polyphenol content and used across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical manufacturing. It delivers antioxidant activity and a characteristic mild, slightly sweet flavor profile that supports both functional and sensory formulation goals. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural antioxidant. It is used as a flavoring agent in teas, ready-to-drink beverages, and functional food products. Nutraceutical formulators incorporate it into dietary supplements and capsule blends targeting antioxidant support positioning. In personal care, it is used in skin-facing formulations such as creams, serums, and toners. Its polyphenol content supports oxidative stability and aligns with clean-label ingredient preferences for modern brands. Pharmaceutical and healthcare product developers also source it for inclusion in standardized botanical preparations. This extract is supplied as a dry powder or spray-dried powder, with liquid extract forms available. Common grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade, with standardized variants specifying aspalathin or total polyphenol content. Organic-certified material is commercially available for brands requiring documentation. The material is produced to meet rigorous industry requirements, including FCC and USP quality standards where applicable.
